author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we are putting together an ultra-small form factor 2.5L gaming PC powered by a 16-core, 32-thread AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX and an NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada Generation GPU with 16GB of GDDR6 VRAM!

Using the Minisforum MS-A2 as the base, the stock enclosure only supports single-slot low-profile cards. To fit the dual-slot low-profile RTX 2000 Ada—which draws all of its power directly from the PCIe slot at up to 70W—I printed a custom 3D-printed top shell designed by JaredC01 on Printables. We test synthetic benchmarks in Geekbench 7 and 3DMark before jumping into 1440p high-settings gaming across Forza Horizon 6, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Cyberpunk 2077, Red Dead Redemption 2, and Crimson Desert, followed by a full CPU and GPU thermal breakdown.
